notes: Create one record for every GDC accession in the frozen corpus; the evaluated run contains 91.
Confirm every accession through the unauthenticated official GDC projects endpoint, which is the highest project/study-level organization endpoint.
Record the returned project state without treating it as the file-level open/controlled access classification.
Set public_metadata_access, released, and study_level_only to true only when the official endpoint supports those project-record claims.
This review does not claim that every file belonging to a project is open access.
The exporter requires the reviewed accession set to match the frozen GDC set exactly.
